name: OpenUsage
description: Private Mattermost bot cards for OpenUsage AI-subscription usage data. Reads the OpenUsage local HTTP API (127.0.0.1:6736) over a netbird-reachable base URL.

settings_schema.header: OpenUsage bot for private AI-subscription usage cards. Set OPENUSAGE_BASE_URL on the Mattermost server process to the OpenUsage local HTTP API. OpenUsage binds 127.0.0.1:6736 and that bind address is not configurable, so a remote Mattermost server must point at a netbird-reachable forwarder that proxies to the host Mac's loopback (e.g. http://<mac-netbird-ip>:6736). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:6736 for same-host installs.
